subject: Exclusive Summer Sale - Limited Time Only!
body: Dear valued customer, We are excited to announce our exclusive summer sale, offering you up to 50% off on select items. Don't miss this opportunity to refresh your wardrobe with the latest summer trends. Hurry, as this sale is only valid for a limited time. Visit our store or shop online to snag the best deals before they're gone. Happy shopping! Warm regards, The Fashion House Team
